overview_description.description: Parallel Bio develops tools that help in the discovery and development of immunotherapies, to eliminate current barriers and create the fastest path to a drug that works. Parallel Bio's platform combines best-in-class human immune organoids with computational methods to generate unprecedented insights into human health and disease.

about_short_description.short_description: Parallel Bio develops tools that help in the discovery and development of immunotherapies.

product.name: Immune Organoids Platform
product.description: A platform that creates in-vitro replicas of human lymph nodes to model human immune responses for drug discovery and testing.

product.name: Trial-in-a-Dish
product.description: A service that predicts drug safety by testing candidates on diverse human immune organoids to simulate population-level responses.

product.name: Disease Modeling
product.description: A service that creates patient-matched immune organoid models to study disease mechanisms and progression.

product.name: Target Discovery
product.description: A service that identifies novel drug targets by analyzing healthy and diseased immune organoids to uncover disease causes.
